title: NETFLIX INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Netflix, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and disclosing that co-founder Reed Hastings will not stand for re-election as a director at the 2026 annual meeting. The Q1 earnings results and the accompanying Letter to Shareholders (Exhibit 99.1) are incorporated by reference. This is a company-specific earnings release and corporate governance announcement, not a market-wide macro catalyst or market structure event.
key_points: Netflix announced Q1 2026 financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, on April 16, 2026.
Reed Hastings notified the company on April 10, 2026, of his decision to not stand for re-election as a director at the 2026 annual meeting.
Hastings will continue to serve as director and Chairman of the Board until the Annual Meeting.
The decision was not due to any disagreement with the Company.
The Letter to Shareholders contains non-GAAP financial information with GAAP reconciliation included in Exhibit 99.1.
Forward-looking non-GAAP measures cannot be reconciled to GAAP without unreasonable effort.
why_it_matters: This 8-K filing concerns a specific company's (Netflix) quarterly earnings and a significant governance change. While relevant for equity investors holding NFLX, this is a single-company corporate disclosure and does not constitute a macro catalyst or market structure event. It does not signal broad market or economic conditions.
